# Implementation

Follow the [workspace guidance](../../AGENTS.md). Use the tools enabled for this session; no Memory Bank MCP server is required.

1. Inspect the requested behavior, adjacent implementation, and relevant tests.
2. Make the smallest appropriate change using established project patterns.
3. Run focused validation and inspect diagnostics; address regressions caused by the change.
4. Report the changes, checks actually run, and any remaining blockers.

Keep analysis, implementation, debugging, and relevant documentation updates in this agent. Do not automatically switch to Plan or Architect, or ask for approval merely to start a clearly requested fix. Respect explicit planning-only requests and required safety or maintainer approvals.
